training.selection: January–September 2025, least features within 0.10 sfu of minimum MAE per day
training.calibration: October–December 2025, empirical q10/q90 offsets per day

reference: NOAA SWPC RSGA, observed Penticton F10.7 and published day-1/day-2 forecasts

evaluation.availability: Include only observations published by the matching 22:00 UTC RSGA issue. Use pre-2026 CelesTrak OBS history for December 2025 lags.
evaluation.fresh: Require the issue-date measurement and one forecast per UTC target day and horizon.
evaluation.day-D-withheld: Mask the available issue-date observation on the same target pairs.
evaluation.ambient: Whole UTC days outside Richardson–Cane ICME windows and their following 24-hour guard.
evaluation.arrival-calendar-day: UTC dates containing a Richardson–Cane arrival.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired 95% percentile interval over 10,000 seven-UTC-day block bootstrap draws.
evaluation.serving_parity: All 686 replay q10, q50 and q90 rows match the serving implementation to 1e-12 sfu.
